automation.title: A bug appears. The flow triages, routes, alerts, and verifies automatically.
automation.text: We design n8n-style incident automations that turn raw errors into structured action: parse context, score severity, notify the right team, create tickets, and keep risky fixes behind approval.

phaseNotes: Errors enter from Sentry, logs, forms, and support channels.
Context is normalized and AI scores impact plus likely root cause.
The flow branches into alerts, tickets, sandbox repair, and approval.
The incident closes only after verification and state sync.

nodes.title: Bug intake
nodes.text: Ingests Sentry issues, logs, forms, and support reports.

nodes.title: Context builder
nodes.text: Deduplicates traces and attaches release, user, and endpoint context.

nodes.title: AI triage
nodes.text: Summarizes likely cause, impact, and confidence before routing.

nodes.title: Severity router
nodes.text: Chooses alert-only, ticket + owner, or automated repair branch.

nodes.title: Slack escalation
nodes.text: Sends an incident brief to the correct channel with proposed actions.

nodes.title: Jira ticket
nodes.text: Opens owner, priority, checklist, and rollback metadata.

nodes.title: Patch sandbox
nodes.text: Tests safe remediation steps outside production first.

nodes.title: QA approval
nodes.text: Human checkpoint before any sensitive write or deploy action.

nodes.title: Verified close
nodes.text: Updates status, stores learnings, and closes the loop.

feed.title: The system narrates what is happening while the workflow continues to run.

items.label: Critical
items.title: Checkout API spike detected
items.meta: Sentry issue merged with gateway logs

metrics.title: Each branch writes structured output back into your stack.

safeguards.title: Automation moves fast. Risky production actions still stay controlled.
items: Rollback notes and blast-radius summary generated before approval.
Low-confidence incidents switch to human review automatically.
Fallback branch opens a war room if repair tests fail.

automation.title: Aparece un bug. El flujo lo clasifica, enruta, alerta y verifica automaticamente.
automation.text: Diseñamos automatizaciones de incidentes tipo n8n que convierten errores crudos en accion estructurada: parsean contexto, puntuan severidad, notifican al equipo correcto, crean tickets y dejan los fixes sensibles detras de aprobacion.

phaseNotes: Los errores entran desde Sentry, logs, formularios y soporte.
El contexto se normaliza y la IA puntua impacto y causa probable.
El flujo abre ramas para alertas, tickets, sandbox de patch y aprobacion.
El incidente se cierra solo despues de verificar y sincronizar estado.

nodes.title: Cierre verificado
